35601.meaning1: name of a privately awakened Buddha
35601.commentary: (MNa) ānando nando upanando dvādasā'ti cattāro ānandā, cattāro nandā cattāro upanandā'ti evaṃ dvādasa.

examples.text: durannayo saṅgho atho'pi ujjayo, aparo muni sayho anomanikkamo, ānando nando upanando dvādasa, bhāradvājo antimadehadhārī.

35602.meaning1: name of an arahant monk; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost monk in admonishing the nuns
35602.commentary: (ANa) bhikkhun'ovādakānaṃ yadidaṃ nandako'ti ayaṃ hi thero dhammakathaṃ kathento ekasamodhāne pañca bhikkhunīsatāni arahattaṃ pāpesi. tasmā bhikkhun'ovādakānaṃ aggo nāma jāto.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā nandako sāvatthiyaṃ viharati pubb'ārāme migāramātupāsāde.
etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhun'ovādakānaṃ yadidaṃ nandako.

35611.meaning2: is glad, rejoices, finds delight in

examples.text: nandati puttehi puttimā, gomā gohi tath'eva nandati, upadhīhi narassa nandanā, na hi so nandati yo nirūpadhī'ti.
idha, bhikkhave, sapatto sapattassa evaṃ icchati, aho vat'āyaṃ dubbaṇṇo assā'ti! taṃ kissa hetu? na, bhikkhave, sapatto sapattassa vaṇṇavatāya nandati.
ekam'antaṃ ṭhito kho nandano devaputto bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi

35616.meaning2: name of a garden in Inda's city
35616.commentary: (SNa) nandane vane'ti ettha taṃ vanaṃ paviṭṭhe paviṭṭhe nandayati tosetī'ti nandanaṃ.

examples.text: bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, aññatarā tāvatiṃsakāyikā devatā nandane vane accharāsaṅghaparivutā dibbehi pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitā samaṅgībhūtā paricāriyamānā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi

so nandane vane accharāsaṅghaparivuto dibbehi pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappito samaṅgībhūto paricāreyya. so passeyya gahapatiṃ vā gahapatiputtaṃ vā pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitaṃ samaṅgībhūtaṃ paricārayamānaṃ.

35620.meaning2: Chapter 2 of the Devatāsaṃyuttaṃ, Book 1 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

35621.meaning1: name of a wood in Tāvatiṃsa heaven

examples.text: tass'imāni pana upabhogaṭṭhānāni, yojanasahass'ubbedho vejayantapāsādo, pañcayojanasat'ubbedhā sudhammā devasabhā, diyaḍḍhayojanasatiko vejayantaratho, tathā erāvaṇo hatthī, dibba-rukkha-sahassa-paṭimaṇḍitaṃ nandanavanaṃ cittalatāvanaṃ phārusakavanaṃ missakavanaṃ.

35623.commentary: (SNa) upadhī hi narassa nandanā'ti… tasmā yathā puttā ca gāvo ca, evaṃ ime'pi upadhī hi narassa nandanā'ti veditabbā.

examples.text: nandati puttehi puttimā, gomā gohi tath'eva nandati, upadhīhi narassa nandanā, na hi so nandati yo nirūpadhī'ti.

35625.meaning1: name of an eminent lay disciple

examples.text: atha kho nandamātā upāsikā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ ekam'antaṃ nisīdi. ekam'antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho nandamātaraṃ upāsikaṃ āyasmā sāriputto etadavoca, ko pana te, nandamāte, bhikkhusaṅghassa abbhāgamanaṃ ārocesī'ti?

35627.commentary: (THa) nandamān'āgataṃ cittā'ti nandamāna abhinandamāna citta abhinandamānaṃ āgataṃ uppannaṃ.

examples.text: nandamān'āgataṃ cittaṃ, sūlam'āropamānakaṃ, tena ten'eva vajasi, yena sūlaṃ kaliṅgaraṃ.

bhante, mama dhītā idha ñātakānaṃ antare nandamānā vicaritvā ito gantvā'pi nandanaṭṭhāneyeva nibbattā'ti. atha naṃ satthā āma, gahapati, appamattā nāma gahaṭṭhā vā pabbajitā vā idha loke ca paraloke ca nandantiyevāti vatvā imaṃ gātham'āha

tena kho pana samayena catasso bhaginiyo bhikkhunīsu pabbajitā honti, nandā, nandavatī, sundarīnandā, thullanandāti. tāsu sundarīnandā bhikkhunī taruṇapabbajitā abhirūpā hoti dassanīyā pāsādikā paṇḍitā byattā medhāvinī dakkhā analasā, tatr'upāyāya vīmaṃsāya samannāgatā, alaṃ kātuṃ alaṃ saṃvidhātuṃ.

35635.notes: Therīgāthā verses 82-86 (TH5.4, TH41) are attributed to her.

examples.text: āturaṃ asuciṃ pūtiṃ, passa nande samussayaṃ, asubhāya cittaṃ bhāvehi, ek'aggaṃ susamāhitaṃ.

35637.synonym: attamanatā, abhinandi, abhirati, pīti, rati, ratī

examples.text: no ce āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti ten'eva dhammarāgena tāya dhammanandiyā pañcannaṃ oram'bhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā
yaṃ kiñci sampajānāsi, uddhaṃ adho tiriyañ'cā'pi majjhe, etesu nandiñ'ca nivesanañ'ca, panujja viññāṇaṃ bhave na tiṭṭhe.

35638.meaning1: was glad; found delight (in); liked; enjoyed
35638.meaning2: was glad, rejoices, found delight in

examples.text: tam'atthaṃ dassetuṃ taṃ devā'ti-ādi vuttaṃ. tattha paṭinandiṃsū'ti punappunaṃ nandiṃsu.

35639.meaning1: destruction of delight; wearing away of enjoyment
35639.commentary: (SNa) nandikkhayā rāgakkhayo, rāgakkhayā nandikkhayo'ti idaṃ nandī'ti vā rāgo'ti vā imesaṃ atthato ninnānākaraṇatāya vuttaṃ. nibbid'ānupassanāya vā nibbindanto nandiṃ pajahati, virāg'ānupassanāya virajjanto rāgaṃ pajahati. ettāvatā vipassanaṃ niṭṭhapetvā rāgakkhayā nandikkhayo'ti idha maggaṃ dassetvā nandirāgakkhayā cittaṃ vimuttan'ti phalaṃ dassitan'ti. (SNt) rāgakkhayā'ti vuṭṭhānagāminipariyosānāya vipassanāya rāgassa khepitattā. anantaraṃ uppannena ariyamaggena samucchedavasena nandikkhayo'ti. ten'āha idha maggaṃ dassetvā'ti.

examples.text: sammā passaṃ nibbindati. nandikkhayā rāgakkhayo, rāgakkhayā nandikkhayo. nandirāgakkhayā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ suvimuttan'ti vuccatī'ti.

35640.meaningLit: discourse on the destruction of delight

35641.meaning2: Chapter 16 of the Saḷāyatanasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 4 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya
35641.meaningLit: section on the destruction of delight

35642.meaning2: was glad, rejoiced, found delight in

35643.meaning2: should be glad, should be rejoice, should be found delight in

35644.meaning2: having been glad, having been rejoice, having found delight in

35645.meaning1: end of enjoyment; cessation of delight

examples.text: tañ'ce bhikkhu n'ābhinandati n'ābhivadati n'ājjhosāya tiṭṭhati, tassa taṃ anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato nirujjhati nandī. nandinirodhā dukkhanirodho, puṇṇā'ti vadāmi

35646.meaning1: extinction of enjoyment in existence; destruction of delight in being; (comm) (or) destruction of delight and existence
35646.commentary: (SNa) nandībhavaparikkhayā'ti nandīmūlakassa kammabhavassa parikkhayena. nandiyā ca bhavassa cā'ti'pi vaṭṭati. tattha hi purimanaye nandībhavena tividhakamm'ābhisaṅkhāravasena saṅkhārakkhandho gahito, saññāviññāṇehi taṃsampayuttā ca dve khandhā. tehi pana tīhi khandhehi sampayuttā vedanā tesaṃ gahaṇena gahitā'vā'ti anupādiṇṇakānaṃ catunnaṃ arūpakkhandhānaṃ appavattivasena saupādisesaṃ nibbānaṃ kathitaṃ hoti.

examples.text: nandibhavaparikkhayā, saññāviññāṇasaṅkhayā, vedanānaṃ nirodhā upasamā, evaṃ khv'āhaṃ, āvuso, jānāmi sattānaṃ nimokkhaṃ pamokkhaṃ vivekan'ti.

35647.meaning1: at first light; at the crack of dawn
35647.meaningLit: when the happy face of the night
35647.commentary: (VINa) nandimukhiyā rattiyā'ti aruṇuṭṭhitakāle'pi hi nandimukhā viya ratti khāyati. ten'āha nandimukhiyā rattiyā'ti.

examples.text: tatiyam'pi kho āyasmā ānando abhikkantāya rattiyā, nikkhante pacchime yāme, uddhaste aruṇe, nandimukhiyā rattiyā uṭṭhāy'āsanā ek'aṃsaṃ uttar'āsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena bhagavā ten'añjaliṃ paṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca

35648.meaning1: happy faced; bright faced; with a cheerful expression
35648.sanskrit: nāndīmukha, nandīmukhā sound of a drum (bsk)

examples.text: tatiyam'pi kho āyasmā ānando abhikkantāya rattiyā, nikkhante pacchime yāme, uddhaste aruṇe, nandimukhiyā rattiyā uṭṭhāy'āsanā ek'aṃsaṃ uttar'āsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena bhagavā ten'añjaliṃ paṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca

35649.commentary: (THa) tassa mātāpitaro nandiṃ janento jāto'ti nandiyo'ti nāmaṃ akaṃsu.
35649.notes: Theragāthā verse 25 (TH1.25, TH25) is attributed to him.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā nātike viharati giñjak'āvasathe. tena kho pana samayena āyasmā ca anuruddho āyasmā ca nandiyo āyasmā ca kimilo gosiṅgasālavanadāye viharanti.

35656.meaning1: delight and desire (in); pleasure and passion (for)

examples.text: luddo'ti kho, bhikkhave, mārassetaṃ pāpimato adhivacanaṃ. papatā'ti kho, bhikkhave, lābhasakkārasilokassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ. suttakan'ti kho, bhikkhave, nandirāgass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, pathavīdhātu, evaṃ catasso viññāṇaṭṭhitiyo daṭṭhabbā. seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, āpodhātu, evaṃ nandirāgo daṭṭhabbo. seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, pañca bījajātāni, evaṃ viññāṇaṃ sāhāraṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.

35657.meaning1: wearing away of delight and desire; exhaustion of enjoyment and passion
35657.commentary: (SNt) anantaraṃ pana uppannena ariyaphalena paṭipassaddhivasena nandirāgakkhayā sabbaṃ saṃkilesato cittaṃ vimuccatī'ti.

examples.text: sammā passaṃ nibbindati. nandikkhayā rāgakkhayo, rāgakkhayā nandikkhayo. nandirāgakkhayā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ suvimuttan'ti vuccatī'ti.

35658.commentary: (PMa) abhinandanasaṅkhātena nandirāgena saha gatā'ti nandirāgasahagatā. nandirāgena saddhiṃ atthato ekattam'eva gatā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: yāyaṃ taṇhā ponobbhavikā nandirāgasahagatā tatratatr'ābhinandinī seyyath'īdaṃ kāmataṇhā bhavataṇhā vibhavataṇhā

35659.meaning1: arising of enjoyment; appearance of delight
35659.commentary: (SNa) nandisamudayā dukkhasamudayo'ti taṇhāya samodhānena pañcakkhandhadukkhassa samodhānaṃ hoti. iti chasu dvāresu, nandisamudayā dukkhasamudayo'ti iminā dvinnaṃ saccānaṃ vasena vaṭṭaṃ matthakaṃ pāpetvā dassesi.

examples.text: tassa taṃ abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato uppajjati nandī. nandisamudayā dukkhasamudayo, puṇṇā'ti vadāmi

35660.meaning1: with delight as bond; having enjoyment as the fetter
35660.commentary: (NIDD2) nandisaṃyojano loko'ti nandī vuccati taṇhā. yo rāgo sārāgo… abhijjhā lobho akusalamūlaṃ, ayaṃ vuccati nandī. yā nandī lokassa saṃyojanaṃ lagganaṃ bandhanaṃ upakkileso, imāya nandiyā loko yutto payutto āyutto samāyutto laggo laggito palibuddhoti, nandisaṃyojano loko.

examples.text: nandisaṃyojano loko, vitakkassa vicāraṇaṃ, taṇhāya vippahānena, nibbānaṃ iti vuccati.

35661.meaning1: bond of delight; fetter of enjoyment
35661.commentary: (NIDD2) nandisaṃyojanaṃ itī'ti nandisaṃyojanaṃ vuccati arūparāgo. arūparāgena taṃ kammaṃ laggaṃ laggitaṃ palibuddhaṃ arūparāgaṃ nandisaṃyojananti ñatvā, lagganan'ti ñatvā, bandhanan'ti ñatvā, palibodho'ti ñatvā jānitvā tulayitvā tīrayitvā vibhāvayitvā vibhūtaṃ katvā.

35662.meaning1: bound with the bond of delight; tied with the fetter of enjoyment

examples.text: nandisaṃyojanasaṃyutto kho, migajāla, bhikkhu sadutiyavihārī'ti vuccati.

35663.meaning1: separated from the bond of delight; free from the fetter of enjoyment

examples.text: nandiyā asati sārāgo na hoti, sārāge asati saṃyogo na hoti. nandisaṃyojanavippayutto kho, migajāla, bhikkhu ekavihārī'ti vuccati. evaṃvihārī ca, migajāla, bhikkhu kiñ'c'āpi gām'ante viharati ākiṇṇo bhikkhūhi bhikkhunīhi upāsakehi upāsikāhi rājūhi rājamah'āmattehi titthiyehi titthiyasāvakehi.

35664.meaning1: detached from the fetter of enjoyment; unbound from the bond of delight

examples.text: nandiyā asati sārāgo na hoti, sārāge asati saṃyogo na hoti. nandisaṃyojanavisaṃyutto kho, migajāla, bhikkhu ekavihārī'ti vuccati
ekam'antaṃ ṭhito kho nandivisālo devaputto bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi
iti bhinnānaṃ vā sandhātā sahitānaṃ vā anuppadātā samagg'ārāmo samaggarato samagganandī samaggakaraṇiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti
ākiñcaññasambhavaṃ ñatvā, nandī saṃyojanaṃ iti, evam'etaṃ abhiññāya, tato tattha vipassati, etaṃ ñāṇaṃ tathaṃ tassa, brāhmaṇassa vusīmato'ti.

35670.synonym: attamanatā, abhinanda, abhinandi, abhirati, pīti, rati, ratī
35670.commentary: (SNa) rāgo'tiādīni lobhass'eva nāmāni. so hi rañjanavasena rāgo, nandanavasena nandī, taṇhāyanavasena taṇhā'ti vuccati.

examples.text: cakkhusmiṃ, āvuso, rūpe cakkhuviññāṇe cakkhuviññāṇaviññātabbesu dhammesu yo chando yo rāgo yā nandī yā taṇhā ye ca upāy'ūpādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhān'ābhinives'ānusayā tesaṃ khayā virāgā nirodhā cāgā paṭinissaggā vimuttaṃ me cittan'ti pajānāmi.
kacci tvaṃ anagho bhikkhu, kacci nandī na vijjati, kacci taṃ ekam'āsīnaṃ, aratī n'ābhikīratī'ti.

35671.meaning1: who is happy; who is enjoying; who is delighting

examples.text: aghajātassa ve nandī, nandījātassa ve aghaṃ, anandī anagho bhikkhu, evaṃ jānāhi āvuso'ti.

35672.meaning1: end of enjoyment; cessation of delight

examples.text: tassa nandīnirodhā upādānanirodho, upādānanirodhā bhavanirodho, bhavanirodhā jātinirodho, jātinirodhā jarāmaraṇaṃ soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsā nirujjhanti. evam'etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hoti.

35673.meaning1: extinction of enjoyment in existence; destruction of delight in being; (comm) (or) destruction of delight and existence
35673.commentary: (SNa) nandībhavaparikkhayā'ti nandīmūlakassa kammabhavassa parikkhayena. nandiyā ca bhavassa cā'ti'pi vaṭṭati.

examples.text: nandībhavaparikkhayā, saññāviññāṇasaṅkhayā, vedanānaṃ nirodhā upasamā, evaṃ khv'āhaṃ āvuso jānāmi sattānaṃ nimokkhaṃ pamokkhaṃ vivekan'ti.
candaṃ'va vimalaṃ suddhaṃ, vippasannam'anāvilaṃ, nandībhavaparikkhīṇaṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.

35675.meaning1: delight and desire; (or) delighting in desire; (comm) three karmic intentions

examples.text: virato kāmasaññāya, rūpasaṃyojan'ātigo, nandīrāgaparikkhīṇo, so gambhīre na sīdatī'ti.
chaṭṭho antaracaro vadhako ukkhittāsiko'ti kho, bhikkhave, nandīrāgass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.

35676.meaning1: who has destroyed delight and desire; (or) who has extinguished delighting in desire; (comm) who has destroyed the three karmic intentions

examples.text: virato kāmasaññāya, rūpasaṃyojan'ātigo, nandīrāgaparikkhīṇo, so gambhīre na sīdatī'ti.

35677.commentary: (DNa) nandīrāgena saha gatā'ti nandīrāgasahagatā. nandīrāgena saddhiṃ atthato ekattam'eva gatā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: katamo c'āvuso, dukkhasamudayo? y'āyaṃ taṇhā ponobbhavikā nandīrāgasahagatā tatratatr'ābhinandinī, seyyath'idaṃ, kāmataṇhā bhavataṇhā vibhavataṇhā, ayaṃ vuccat'āvuso, dukkhasamudayo.

35678.meaning1: arising of enjoyment; appearance of delight
35678.commentary: (MNa) nandīsamudayā dukkhasamudayo'ti nandiyā taṇhāya samodhānena pañcakkhandhadukkhassa samodhānaṃ hoti. iti chasu dvāresu dukkhaṃ samudayo'ti dvinnaṃ saccānaṃ vasena vaṭṭaṃ matthakaṃ pāpetvā dassesi. dutiyanaye nirodho maggo'ti dvinnaṃ saccānaṃ vasena vivaṭṭaṃ matthakaṃ pāpetvā dassesi.

examples.text: tassa taṃ abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato uppajjati nandī. nandīsamudayā dukkhasamudayo, puṇṇā'ti vadāmi.

35679.meaning1: having delight as a bond; having enjoyment as the fetter

examples.text: nandīsambandhano loko, vitakkassa vicāraṇaṃ, taṇhāya vippahānena, sabbaṃ chindati bandhanan'ti.

35680.meaning1: with delight as bond; having enjoyment as the fetter

examples.text: nandīsaṃyojano loko, vitakkassa vicāraṇaṃ, taṇhāya vippahānena, nibbānaṃ iti vuccatī'ti.

35682.meaning1: sprinkled with delight; nourished by enjoyment
35682.commentary: (DNa) nand'ūpasecanan'ti lobhasahagataṃ sampayuttanandiyā'va upasittaṃ hutvā. itaraṃ upanissayakoṭiyā.

examples.text: upayo, bhikkhave, avimutto, anupayo vimutto. rūp'upayaṃ vā, bhikkhave, viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭheyya, rūp'ārammaṇaṃ rūpappatiṭṭhaṃ nand'ūpasecanaṃ vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyya.
chetvā nandhiṃ varattañ'ca, sandānaṃ sah'anukkamaṃ, ukkhittapalighaṃ buddhaṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.

35688.meaning1: should not be rejected; should not be disdained

examples.text: ye'pi te, bhikkhave, ahesuṃ okkalā vassabhaññā ahetuvādā akiriyavādā n'atthikavādā te'pi mahācattārīsakaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ na garahitabbaṃ napaṭikkositabbaṃ amaññiṃsu.

35689.grammar: pr, from na paṭijānāti, neg, trans (+acc)
35689.meaning1: does not admit; does not acknowledge
35689.construction:
na + pati + jānā + ti
na + paṭijānāti

examples.text: so evam'āha, imañ'hi nām'āhaṃ, āvuso, appamattikaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjitvā apuṭṭho paṭijānissāmi. kiṃ pan'āhaṃ evarūpiṃ garukaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjitvā pārājikaṃ vā pārājikasāmantaṃ vā puṭṭho napaṭijānissāmī'ti?

35690.meaning2: does not land; does not alight (on)

35691.meaning1: not the best kind; not the best sort; pretty ugly
35691.commentary: (MNa) naparamarūpan'ti na puññavantānaṃ gehaṃ viya uttamarūpaṃ… naparamarūpan'ti yathā puññavantānaṃ gandhasālibīj'ādi parisuddhaṃ bījaṃ, na evarūpaṃ… naparamarūpā'ti pacchisīsā lambatthanī mah'odarā pisācā viya bībhacchā.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, udāyi, puriso daliddo assako anāḷhiyo, tass'assa ekaṃ agārakaṃ oluggaviluggaṃ kāk'ātidāyiṃ naparamarūpaṃ, ekā khaṭopikā oluggaviluggā naparamarūpā, ekissā kumbhiyā dhaññasamavāpakaṃ naparamarūpaṃ, ekā jāyikā naparamarūpā.

examples.text: naparamparabhojane paramparabhojanasaññī, āpatti dukkaṭassa. naparamparabhojane vematiko, āpatti dukkaṭassa. naparamparabhojane naparamparabhojanasaññī, anāpatti.

35693.meaning1: perceiving (oneself) as not eating one meal after the other

examples.text: naparamparabhojane paramparabhojanasaññī, āpatti dukkaṭassa. naparamparabhojane vematiko, āpatti dukkaṭassa. naparamparabhojane naparamparabhojanasaññī, anāpatti.
na brāhmaṇo kappam'upeti saṅkhā, na diṭṭhisārī na'pi ñāṇabandhu, ñatvā ca so sammutiyo puthujjā, upekkhatī uggahaṇanti m'aññe.
ekaccā devatā evam'āhaṃsu, na kālaṅ'kato samaṇo gotamo, na'pi kālaṅ'karoti, arahaṃ samaṇo gotamo, vihārotv'eva so arahato evarūpo hotī'ti.

35695.meaning1: not one's father before; not previously one's father
35695.commentary: (SNa) tesu imasmiṃ cakkavāḷe mātugāmakāle mātubhūtaññ'eva dassento yo namātābhūtapubbo'ti āha. yo napitābhūtapubbo'ti-ādīsu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: anamataggo'yaṃ, bhikkhave, saṃsāro … na so, bhikkhave, satto sulabharūpo yo napitābhūtapubbo … alaṃ vimuccitun'ti.

35696.meaning1: not wishing to be loved; not wanting to be dear; not wishing to endear oneself
35696.commentary: (VINa) piyakamyassa vā'ti evaṃ ahaṃ etassa piyo bhavissāmī'ti attano piyabhāvaṃ patthayamānassa vā.

examples.text: anāpatti napiyakamyassa, nabhed'ādhippāyassa, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

35697.meaning1: not one's son before; not previously one's son
35697.commentary: (SNa) tesu imasmiṃ cakkavāḷe mātugāmakāle mātubhūtaññ'eva dassento yo namātābhūtapubbo'ti āha. yo napitābhūtapubbo'ti-ādīsu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: na so, bhikkhave, satto sulabharūpo yo naputtabhūtapubbo … alaṃ vimuccitun'ti.
320, 335. so napuṃsakaliṅgo
so abyayībhāvasamāso napuṃsakaliṅgo'va daṭṭhabbo.
342, 337. saro rasso napuṃsake.
napuṃsake vattamānassa abyayībhāvasamāsassa liṅgassa saro rasso hoti. kumārīsu adhikicca pavattati kathā iti adhikumāri. upavadhu, upagaṅgaṃ, upamaṇikaṃ.
